title: Nne Ahofama a Ɛwɔ Odiyifo Bi Akyi
intro: Wɔ asase bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri so no, ɔbɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔdehye bi hyiaa pow a emu yɛ den fi tumidi a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no hɔ. Nanso akra a wɔatu wɔn ho ama kurukuruwa ketewa bi gyinaa Allah akoa yi nkyɛn, a na wɔn ho pere wɔn sɛ wobebua ɔsoro frɛ bi. Ná wɔn gyidi a enhinhim no bɛpaapae ɔman a ɛwɔ tumi mu na awiei koraa no wɔadi tumi ahorow a wonnye nni no so nkonim.
clues: Ná yɛyɛ kuw ketewaa bi a wɔatu wɔn ho ama, a yɛayɛ biako wɔ gyidi ne atirimpɔw mu.
Yegyinaa ɔbɔfo a ɔyɛ ɔdehye bi a wɔn asase so atumfoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi no pow no nkyɛn.
Bere a saa 3somafo yi bisaa se, 'Hwan ne m'akyigyinafoa wo Allah kwan so?' yɛbuae a yɛantwentwɛn yɛn nan ase.
Yɛsrɛɛ ɔbɔfo yi sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ apontow bi mfi soro mfa awerɛhyem mmra yɛn koma mu.
Wɔ saa berɛ no mu nnipa mu no, ebinom nam yɛn nkra no so gye dii na ebinom nso de wɔn tirim powee, nanso Allah hyɛɛ agyidifoɔ no den.
Yɛyɛ Hawwariyyun — Isa asuafoɔ a wɔatu wɔn ho ama, a wɔnam Allah mmoa so yɛɛ nkonimdiefoɔ.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
